sections.overall: A mixed bag in the end for Blood and Guts '26. The women's match was excellent, and among the highest-rated in that format since its inception in 2021. It was also the best match of the week, which we totally agree with! The men's match was less well-received. A step down from last year but a decent event overall.
sections.mens: The best Men's singles match was the National Title change of Tommaso Ciampa vs Andrade El Idolo (7.54), main eventing Collision on the Norwegian Jewel. Neither man's best this year but a small gain for both.
sections.womens: Persephone pulled double duty this week: starring in Blood and Guts and overcoming Mina Shirakawa on Collision, the latter returning to the rankings. Good gains for all women involved in the best match of the week.
sections.menstag: Several tag teams were involved in the men's Blood and Guts, but the modest match rating led to little gains or losses. The best straight tag, again, was FTR vs The Motor City Machine Guns (7.58). Tied 2-2 in their series, will the final match feature on Full Gear?
sections.womenstag: All four Women's Tag Teams in the rankings were featured in the brutal bout, all gaining well and pushing both Divine Dominion and The Brawling Birds back to "bronze" (120+). Also the peak rating for both teams!
sections.trios: We had a decent match on Collision between Garcia, Kidd and Moxley vs Infantry & Taylor (5.52), though little was gained from either team. This division needs some reheating!
